density_unavailable_policy: If the training-fold COMMON universe is smaller than a requested fixed K, mark that density unavailable; never silently cap K.

marker_rank.selection: filter static physical-bin rank to fold-eligible COMMON markers then take its prefix

primary.protocol: Five outer folds and four inner folds; balance published genetic groups and keep near-identical accession blocks together.
primary.model_class: additive genomic kernel baseline specified by configs/baseline.json

confirmatory_decision.positive_effect_point_exceeds_SESOI: conditional 95% block-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND point delta_Q2 >= 0.01; this is not a practical-importance claim
confirmatory_decision.practical_equivalence: conditional 90% block-bootstrap CI lies entirely in [-0.01, 0.01]

bootstrap.conditioning: conditional on fitted OOF predictions; excludes retraining/tuning variance

multiplicity: The primary comparison is DTF1 with group-balanced splits, COMMON_ALL versus COMMON_250K, evaluated by delta_Q2. Trait 748 is assessed separately using the same decision rules.

density_availability.COMMON_1M: Unavailable in all 237 prepared training partitions; do not fit or cap the requested marker count.
density_availability.primary_scope: Tests whether high-quality training-fold COMMON SNP density beyond 250K, up to the fold-specific COMMON_ALL universe, improves prediction.
density_availability.not_identified: This comparison does not estimate the effect of all 10.7 million SNPs or rare variants.

nearclone_scope: None of the four selected trait cohorts contains multiple members of the same exact d<=0.001 block. The primary split is not an evaluation on unrelated populations.
